args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb 2026. Same customer, same account.
- A saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". It should read Pellow Home Living.
- Staff are seeing both names: "Covey" and "PHL" shorthand in older reports and exports. PHL is also the code for Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so check the dropdowns when filing tickets.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows. The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- Ask: rename the saved report label (and any export headers still on Covey & Lark) so the old name stops causing double searches.

Thanks
